<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/complaint">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Complaint" name="Complaint"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Decision" name="Complaint decision"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Refund" name="Refund"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Feedback" name="Customer feedback"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Complaint">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company" processRef="Process_Complaint"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Complaint" name="Files complaint"
                      sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_Complaint"
                      messageRef="Message_Complaint"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Decision" name="Notifies customer of decision"
                      sourceRef="Task_NotifyCustomer" targetRef="Participant_Customer"
                      messageRef="Message_Decision"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Refund" name="Refund"
                      sourceRef="Task_ProcessRefund" targetRef="Participant_Customer"
                      messageRef="Message_Refund"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Feedback" name="Provides feedback"
                      sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_Feedback"
                      messageRef="Message_Feedback"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Complaint" name="Handle complaint" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Complaint" name="Complaint filed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Complaint" messageRef="Message_Complaint"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LogComplaint" name="Customer service logs complaint"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssignComplaint" name="Assign complaint to relevant department"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssessComplaint" name="Review details and assess validity and refund eligibility"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyCustomer" name="Notify customer of decision" messageRef="Message_Decision"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefundApproved" name="Refund approved?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcessRefund" name="Financial team processes reimbursement"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ResolveAfterRefund" name="Mark complaint resolved after customer receives refund"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ResolveRejected" name="Mark complaint resolved after notifying customer of rejected refund"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_RefundResolved" name="Complaint resolved after refund"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_RejectedResolved" name="Complaint resolved after rejected refund"/>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Feedback" name="Customer provides feedback">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Feedback" messageRef="Message_Feedback"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FeedbackReceived" name="Feedback received"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Complaint_Log" sourceRef="Start_Complaint" targetRef="Task_LogComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Log_Assign" sourceRef="Task_LogComplaint" targetRef="Task_AssignComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assign_Assess" sourceRef="Task_AssignComplaint" targetRef="Task_AssessComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assess_Notify" sourceRef="Task_AssessComplaint" targetRef="Task_NotifyCustomer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Notify_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_NotifyCustomer" targetRef="Gateway_RefundApproved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundApproved" targetRef="Task_ProcessRefund">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">refundApproved = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Rejected" name="Rejected" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundApproved" targetRef="Task_ResolveRejected">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">refundApproved = false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Refund_Resolve" sourceRef="Task_ProcessRefund" targetRef="Task_ResolveAfterRefund"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Resolve_RefundEnd" sourceRef="Task_ResolveAfterRefund" targetRef="End_RefundResolved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Rejected_ResolveEnd" sourceRef="Task_ResolveRejected" targetRef="End_RejectedResolved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Feedback_End" sourceRef="Start_Feedback" targetRef="End_FeedbackReceived"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
